product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides cloud-based web and mobile testing and AI-driven test authoring, execution and analysis for enterprise developers and quality-assurance teams.

eng_blog.notes: Daniel Louvier describes infrastructure automation for the Real Device Cloud; software engineer Sakhi Mansoor describes the DevTools application architecture and delivery pipeline.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public job posting seeks an AI Architect in Gurugram, India.

model_provider.notes: The AI Architect posting explicitly describes integrating with “our self-hosted versions of Gemini Flash models.” AURA also announced bring-your-own-model support on 2026-08-19; this is not a claim of exclusive reliance on Google.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 are audit/certification claims; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest database-reported round: Tracxn dates Series G to 2024-01-26; Indexed reports $79.9 million (labelled Series G+). No corresponding company announcement was located. The latest company-confirmed financing announcement located is an undisclosed TPG strategic investment on 2022-06-07; funding sources disagree, so the 2024 details are qualified rather than company-confirmed.

raised_18mo.notes: No round is recorded in 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09: the latest database-reported round is January 2024, and the latest company-confirmed announcement located is June 2022, both before the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting for Sales Development Representative in London.

launched_6mo.notes: AURA, an agentic test-authoring, execution and analysis platform, launched on 2026-07-22, within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-04-16, Sauce Labs announced Steven Fitz as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as Senior Vice President of Global Marketing, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires tracking activity in Salesforce.com; Outreach, Salesloft and ZoomInfo are named as preferred-experience examples, not independently confirmed deployments.
